result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A groups the fields more clearly. Its section headings (Profile, Practice and notifications) and wider gaps between groups make the related controls easy to spot, and its padding is generous inside a single unnested card. B keeps labels close to their inputs and clearly sets Delete account apart in its own red-bordered card. However, B places the reminder time in the same group as the profile fields and uses tighter padding. A's screenshot cuts off before its Delete account area and Save button, so I couldn't check item 3 for A and scored it as neutral. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both use the same clean dark-card layout with tight label-to-input spacing. B groups the fields a bit better, with a 'Profile' section and a 'Practice and notifications' section, and its padding is roomier. B's screenshot cuts off before the Delete account area, so its separation can't be checked, while A visibly puts Delete account in its own red-bordered card below the main panel and keeps Save next to the settings. I picked A because more of the rubric can be confirmed from its screenshot.
